Ceramic building material. Tile. Fragment of an oxidised fabric with smooth, possibly slipped, outer surface which bears three slightly angled lines, the first as viewed with a single horizontal bar, in low relief: perhaps partial characters or letters. This object was kindly identified by Helen Fry and Sandra Firth of the North Lincolnshire Pottery Research Group. Suggested date: possibly Roman,…
